WITH per_id AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg_ana
    FROM per_id
)
SELECT p.ID,
       p.avg_ana,
       p.avg_ana - m.mean_avg_ana AS gap_above_mean
FROM per_id AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_ana > m.mean_avg_ana
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
